items.stem: What does the Delta transaction log primarily provide over a plain folder of Parquet files?

options.text: ACID guarantees, versioning and time travel
options.rationale: Correct: the transaction log gives atomic commits, versioning and time travel.

options.text: Faster single-row key lookups like a cache
options.rationale: It is not a key-value cache for single-row lookups.

options.text: Removal of the need for any storage
options.rationale: Data still must be stored; the log tracks it.

items.explanation: Correct: the transaction log gives atomic commits, versioning and time travel.

items.stem: Apache Iceberg's hidden partitioning lets you do what?

options.text: Query by a column without manually managing partition path values
options.rationale: Correct: Iceberg tracks partition values in metadata so queries need not reference partition columns explicitly.
Iceberg still stores data in files.
Hidden partitioning does not disable ACID.

items.explanation: Correct: Iceberg tracks partition values in metadata so queries need not reference partition columns explicitly.

items.stem: Which TWO are routine maintenance tasks for open table formats? (Select TWO)

options.text: Compacting many small files into fewer larger ones
options.rationale: Correct: compaction improves read performance by reducing small files.

options.text: Expiring old snapshots to reclaim storage
options.rationale: Correct: expiring stale snapshots frees storage safely.

options.text: Deleting the transaction log to save space
options.rationale: Deleting the transaction log would corrupt the table's history.
Disabling schema enforcement removes protection against bad data.

items.explanation: Correct: compaction improves read performance by reducing small files.; Correct: expiring stale snapshots frees storage safely.
